name: Straight razor
definition: single open blade that folds into its handle, honed and stropped by the user.
notes: Parker SRX Barber Straight Razor listed beside safety razors; Lamnia article covers fixed and folding straight razors.

name: Shavette
definition: open-blade razor that holds a disposable blade.
notes: Shavettes listed as razor knives with replaceable blades; shop navigation lists Shavettes apart from straight razors.

name: Single-edge safety razor
definition: guarded razor holding a blade with one cutting edge.
notes: Natu Copper Pivoting Head Single-Edge Safety Razor sold as single-edge safety razor.

name: Double-edge safety razor
definition: guarded razor holding a blade with two cutting edges.
notes: Merkur 34C and Henson AL13 DE safety razors; B&B database lists DE razors by maker and model.

name: Cartridge razor
definition: razor with a handle that takes a multi-blade cartridge (a disposable razor is this kind with `disposable` = yes).
notes: Gillette Fusion5 ProGlide razor handle sold with cartridge refills; five-blade cartridge.

name: Shaving brush
definition: brush made for lathering soap or cream on the face.
notes: Shaving Brush filter type; brushes of badger, boar and synthetic hair sold by Yaqi, Simpson, Omega.

name: Wet-shaving kit
definition: starter kit of razor, brush and preparation sold and compared as one object.
notes: Maggard Razors Standard Wet Shaving Starter Kit: razor, brush, soap, blades; shop also lists Shaving Kits.

name: Electric shaver
definition: powered shaver with foil or rotary heads.
notes: Type filter lists foil shavers and rotary shavers; Braun, Philips, Remington, Panasonic.

name: Hair clipper
definition: powered clipper that cuts head hair to a set length.
notes: Hair clippers listed as own type: Wahl Color Pro, Complete Cut Pro.

name: Beard trimmer
definition: powered trimmer made for beards and body grooming.
notes: Beard and stubble trimmers listed as own type: Braun Beard Trimmer Series 3 and 7, Wahl Color Trim.

name: Tweezers
definition: hand tool that grips and plucks single hairs.
notes: Tweezerman Slant Tweezer, stainless steel, 25-degree slanted tip for brows.

name: Shaving soap
definition: soap made to be lathered with a shaving brush, sold as a hard puck or tub, a soft soap (croap) or a shaving stick.
notes: Type filter Shaving Soap, apart from Shaving Cream; soaps by Stirling, Ariana & Evans, Arko stick.

name: Shaving cream
definition: cream applied before shaving that lathers by hand or brush.
notes: Type filter Shaving Cream; Proraso and Taylor of Old Bond Street creams and bowls.

name: Aftershave
definition: product applied to the skin after shaving (an aftershave balm is this kind with format = balm).
notes: Type filter After Shave; splashes, lotions and an alcohol-free aftershave balm.

name: Body wash
definition: liquid bath and shower preparation for washing the body.
notes: Body washes category with Old Spice, eos and Native body wash.

name: Toilet soap bar
definition: bar of soap made for washing the body.
notes: Bar Soaps category (Dr. Squatch natural bar soap) apart from body wash.

name: Wet wipe
definition: moist wipe for cleaning the skin (baby wipes carry user = baby).
notes: Femfresh Pocket Wipes and Sensitive Wipes for intimate skin; baby wipes sold in nappy-changing range.

name: Deodorant
definition: product that masks or reduces body odour, antiperspirants included (a deodorant wipe is this kind with format = wipe).
notes: Deodorants category: Dove, Degree antiperspirant spray, Native aluminum-free deodorant.

name: Intimate wash
definition: wash made for external intimate hygiene.
notes: Femfresh Intimate Hygiene Daily Wash and Wash Sensitive; EpZen Intimate Gel Wash.

name: Menstrual pad
definition: disposable or reusable pad worn to absorb menstrual flow.
notes: Libra, U by Kotex, Hello Period and Tom Organic pads including maternity and overnight.

name: Tampon
definition: absorbent plug inserted to absorb menstrual flow.
notes: Libra Tampons and Tom Organic Tampons in mini, regular, super.

name: Menstrual cup
definition: reusable cup inserted to collect menstrual flow.
notes: Hello Period cervix cup and disc; shop text names Diva Cup among menstrual cups.

name: Personal lubricant
definition: lubricant applied to the intimate area.
notes: Astroglide water-based and silicone lubricants, liquid and gel.

name: Anal douche
definition: bulb or device for rinsing the rectum.
notes: Douche and Enema Flush Bulb for anal or vaginal use, listed with similar bulb kits.

name: Potty
definition: small free-standing toilet bowl for a child.
notes: Potty named as toileting product beside nappies in Baby Bunting changing range.

name: Toilet-training seat
definition: child seat that fits on an adult toilet.
notes: Toilet training seat described as separate from potty.

name: Changing mat
definition: padded mat on which a baby is changed.
notes: Change Pads and change mats listed in Baby Changing.

name: Nappy
definition: disposable or cloth garment that absorbs a baby's urine and faeces.
notes: Nappies listed, disposable or cloth, with Huggies among brands.

name: Baby bath
definition: small tub made for bathing a baby.
notes: Baby baths for bathing until the baby sits unaided.

name: Loofah or bath sponge
definition: natural or synthetic sponge or loofah sold for washing the body.
notes: Loofahs listed as bath accessory; Tree Hut scrub with pink mesh loofah set.

name: Pumice
definition: pumice stone sold for smoothing the skin.
notes: Foot File and Pumice Stone aisle: Pure Body Pumice Stone black, gray, red.

name: Toothpaste (dentifrice)
definition: paste or gel for cleaning the teeth.
notes: Toothpaste category with Colgate, Elmex, Sensodyne, Parodontax, Curaprox, Vitis.

name: Electric toothbrush
definition: powered toothbrush with an oscillating or vibrating head.
notes: Oral-B iO6, iO3, Vitality Pro and Ordo Sonic electric toothbrushes.

name: Grooming mirror
definition: mirror made for grooming, lit or magnifying (a wall or dresser mirror is B4).
notes: 10x magnifying LED makeup mirror with suction cup, brand SNQ.

name: Bathroom scale
definition: scale for weighing the body.
notes: Salter digital and electronic bathroom scales category.

name: Nail clippers
definition: hand tool that cuts finger or toe nails.
notes: ZWILLING TWINOX toenail clippers with nail catcher; Seki Edge toe nail clipper.

name: Nail file
definition: file or emery board that shapes nails.
notes: Crystal glass nail files, Czech tempered glass, reusable and washable.

name: Manicure set
definition: kit of nail implements sold and compared as one object.
notes: Superdrug 5 Piece Manicure Set: tweezer, nail file, scissors, clippers, shaper in pouch.

name: Toiletry bag
definition: case made to carry toiletries.
notes: BAGSMART hanging toiletry bags and dopp kits.

name: Make-up bag
definition: case made to carry makeup.
notes: BAGSMART collection tagged Makeup Bag; page leads with toiletry bags, makeup bag only a tag.

name: Barber chair
definition: reclining, height-adjustable chair made for cutting hair and shaving.
notes: OmySalon BC1501 hydraulic reclining barber chair; DIR Vanquish and Berkeley Lincoln barber chairs.

name: Hot-water bottle
definition: sealed rubber or plastic bottle filled with hot water for warmth.
notes: Hot Water Bottles in First Aid: rubber, silicone and electric rechargeable bottles.

name: Massager
definition: handheld or powered massager made for comfort, percussion and neck massagers included.
notes: HoMedics percussion massage guns and neck and shoulder heat massagers; Therabody Theragun.

name: Pacifier
definition: teat for a baby to suck that is not used for feeding.
notes: Category intro names dummies, soothers and pacifiers; no products shown; MAM teethers page mentions soothers.

name: Massage chair
definition: powered chair that massages the seated user.
notes: HoMedics Max Shiatsu Massaging Chair and Full Body Flex; zero gravity chairs by Positive Posture, OHCO.

name: Razor cartridge
definition: replaceable multi-blade cartridge for a cartridge razor.
notes: Gillette ProGlide razor blade refills with five blades, fit ProGlide and Fusion5 handles.

name: Double-edge blade
definition: replacement blade with two cutting edges for a double-edge safety razor.
notes: Double edge razor blades by Astra, Merkur, Personna, Gillette, Dovo, KAI.

name: Single-edge blade
definition: replacement blade with one cutting edge for a single-edge safety razor.
notes: Gillette Guard single edge cartridge refills in Blades category; Feather AC single-edge blades are for straight razors.

name: Shaver foil or head
definition: replacement foil, cutter or rotary head for an electric shaver.
notes: Replacement foils and shaver heads: Philips SH50 head, Braun Series 7 head, Philips OneBlade blades.

name: Clipper guard
definition: attachment comb that sets the cutting length of a clipper or trimmer.
notes: Wahl Attachment Comb Set No. 1-8 clipper guide combs.

name: Toothbrush head
definition: replacement brush head for an electric toothbrush.
notes: Oral-B iO and CrossAction replacement brush heads; Ordo Sonic heads.

name: Dryer attachment
definition: nozzle or diffuser made to fit a hair dryer.
notes: Dyson Supersonic diffuser, styling concentrator, smoothing nozzle attachments.

name: Razor strop
definition: strip of leather or canvas, hanging, paddle or loom type, on which the edge of a straight razor is realigned before shaving (the strop type is not a kind).
notes: Hanging, paddle and bench razor strops by Herold, Boker, Marbles, Brommeland.
